If the power supply in the game does not meet these requirements, it should be replaced prior to beginning the conversion procedures.
The control panel on the game to be converted can be either metal or wood. When selecting a game to convert consider the placement of joystick, push buttons and the monitor position.

Route the wires labeled control 1 (for upright) to your control panel. Cut this down to the required length. Strip and solder the wires to the joystick, and push buttons according to the pin-out assignments.
Route the wires labelled "VIDEO" or "MONITOR" up to your monitor and cut the excess wire. Refer to the Pin-out assignment at the back of this manual for video outputs.
